name: lyria
description: Generate music files using Google Gemini Lyria 3. Auto-selects the model by request/purpose: Lyria 3 Pro for full-length structured songs with lyrics, Lyria 3 Clip for 30s clips, loops, and jingles. Supports genre/mood/instrument prompting, song-structure tags, MP3/WAV output. Works with Gemini Developer API and Vertex AI.
